filled_phases.content: Find ball price b. Bat=b+1.00. Total b+(b+1.00)=1.10. Failure = 0.10 (intuitive trap).
A: words->equations. B: solve 2b+1.00=1.10. C: verify constraints. Load-bearing: 'more than'=additive.
H1=0.10 (obvious, wrong). H2=0.05 (bat 1.05). H3: negative impossible. H4=H2 verified.
Positivity ok; 'more than' additive; general b=(T-D)/2=0.05; no off-by-one.

final_answer: The ball costs $0.05 (5 cents). The bat costs $1.05; together $1.10.
